title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Galley Proof. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Galley Proof
options.lineage: Letterpress galley proofs and publisher pass sheets
options.thesis: The forme stays on the stone until both columns of the proof agree.
options.viewport: A full-bleed proof sheet: flow as the galley headline, two columns Mechanical and Semantic, the install line waiting to go to press.
options.risk: Cream paper plus a timid serif collapses into the docs-methodology rut.

options.label: Terminal Yellow
options.thesis: Nine minutes to the gate: one yellow band, one next decision, then walk.
options.viewport: A yellow overhead band owns the first viewport; gate-scale Install sits at the arrow; two inset bands read Mechanical and Semantic.
options.case: Wins the ten-second next-gate job; two required bands can stand in for the layers. Does not beat the assigned on kill-as-valid product clarity.
options.risk: Reads as an airline microsite if the install command is not the only next gate.

options.label: Seven-Segment
options.thesis: Every glyph is the same eight-cell mask; unlit segments are designed too.
options.viewport: Four red segment cells spell flow; a second row holds the install command; ghost cells mark the unset clock as the kill state.
options.case: Fuses poorly because a clock and scoreboard sell time and score, not a killable two-layer gate.
options.risk: Gadget chrome swallows the harness; the visitor remembers digits, not discipline.

options.label: Rain-Night City
options.thesis: Trains stitch amber across the river while rain doubles every sign.
options.viewport: A stacked night: skyline, street, reflection; flow as a civic sign; install as the one lit storefront.
options.case: Fuses poorly because wet neon night is the AI-agent landing the brief forbids.
options.risk: Even executed well, it reads as another coding-agent nocturne.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark AI-coding-agent landing with a terminal hero, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Centered wordmark, glowing terminal pane, install below the fold of a star row.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every neighboring agent product; flow’s kill switch disappears.
